description.value: Kathmandu Bar & Grill is a full-service restaurant and bar blending Nepalese, Indo-Chinese, and Western cuisine, with halal options also available. Located on Scott Road in Surrey, it offers dine-in with table reservations, takeout, and delivery across a 15 km radius. The menu is developed in-house by expert chefs aiming to merge culinary traditions into a cohesive dining experience.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and confirms an active restaurant at 9340 120 St, Surrey, BC V3V 4B8, with phone 778-654-8555 — but the OSM community field says 'Richmond', a clear location discrepancy. Takeout/pickup is explicitly confirmed on the website ('PICK UP AVAILABLE', 'Pickup in 20-30 mins'). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those are null.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Richmond' but website address is '9340 120 St, Surrey, BC V3V 4B8' — the business is in Surrey, not Richmond. OSM community tag may be incorrect.

Website branding is 'Kathmandu Bar and Grill Scott Road', indicating this is one of at least two locations (a 'Guildford' location is also listed on the website). The OSM record has no address to confirm which location it maps to.
OSM name uses '&' ('Kathmandu Bar & Grill') while website consistently uses 'and' ('Kathmandu Bar and Grill').
OSM cuisine tag ('western;international') is incomplete — website states Nepalese, Indo-Chinese, and Western cuisine.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, online ordering, and OSM check_date of 2026-04-05. Useful to touring cyclists for food and takeout.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone (778-654-8555) and address (9340 120 St, Surrey, BC V3V 4B8) sourced from website; neither was present in OSM tags. contact_confirmed fields are null for phone and address because OSM had no values to corroborate.

wow_evidence: full-service restaurant and bar blending Nepalese, Indo-Chinese, and Western cuisine
